cta_text.description: The ONE CTA phrase, one of allowed_cta_texts. The renderer reuses it verbatim in the first screen, the closing band and the sticky bar.

cta_url.description: The ONE CTA destination. No other url, link, button or phone field may appear anywhere in page.json (gate landing:second_cta).

eyebrow.description: The ad's hook in at most 8 words, no number.

accent_phrase.description: 1-4 words copied from headline; shown in brand red (no accent when not found).

subhead.description: The ad's promise in plain words, at most 30 words.

hero_image.description: Fallback product photo; the ad still (when the run has one) or the product cut-out is shown first.

checked_claims.description: 4-6 items: what the ad said, and the verified fact behind it. Cover electrical requirement, footprint, delivery, assembly, warranty where facts exist. At least 3 items cite a product spec or benefit claim.

ad_said.description: What the ad said or implied, at most 18 words. The one place an ad claim the facts contradict may appear; fact corrects it.

fact.description: The verified statement, at most 36 words.

room_photo.description: Optional: one photo of the product in a real room (asset kind lifestyle/installation). Omit when facts_pack has none -- never a render.

benefits.description: PROOF LOOK ONLY (write it only when the hard constraints say the page renders in the proof look; otherwise omit). 4-6 check-mark rows, each a plain noun phrase of at most 8 words with claim_ids; at least one id per row is a product spec or benefit claim or a benefit allowlist id.

text.description: A plain noun phrase, at most 8 words, no full stop.

icon_row.description: PROOF LOOK ONLY (otherwise omit). 3-4 icon cells before the closing band, each {icon_key, label, claim_ids}. icon_key is one of the fixed keys the hard constraints list; no key twice.

icon_key.description: One of: shipping, warranty, red_light, full_spectrum, wood, us_owned, delivery, assembly.

claim_ids.description: At least 1 id from facts_pack.verified_claims that states it.

proof.description: Optional. The rating is rendered from facts_pack; quote only one customer review copied verbatim from facts_pack.review_quotes. The rating sentence in reviews_summary is never a quote. Omit when review_quotes is empty.

questions.description: 3-5 entries from the ad's objections and buyer logistics. Question <= 12 words; answer first, <= 35 words; claim_ids on any number, price, spec or trigger word.

closing.description: The closing band. The renderer adds the CTA pill and the financing and warranty sentences.
